customer.terms:
# Customer Terms of Service

Welcome to Findivo!

## 1. Introduction
These Terms govern your access to the Findivo app as a customer. By creating an account, you agree to abide by these rules.

## 2. Account Registration
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.

## 3. Purchases & Payments
All transactions are securely processed. Findivo acts as a marketplace platform connecting you with independent retailers. Product quality, shipping, and returns are generally handled by the respective seller unless stated otherwise.

## 4. User Conduct
You agree not to misuse the platform, post spam, or engage in any fraudulent activity.
customer.privacy:
# Customer Privacy Policy

Your privacy is paramount to us at Findivo.

## 1. Data Collection
We collect basic information such as your name, email, and phone number when you register. We also track your purchase history and app usage to provide a personalized shopping experience.

## 2. Data Usage
Your data is used strictly for fulfilling your orders, processing payments, and personalizing your product feed.

## 3. Data Sharing
We share necessary order details (e.g., shipping address) with the Retailer fulfilling your order. We do not sell your personal data to third-party marketers.

## 4. Security
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information.

retailer.terms:
# Retailer Terms of Service

Welcome to Findivo for Merchants!

## 1. Merchant Responsibilities
As a Retailer, you agree to provide accurate business information, maintain up-to-date inventory, and fulfill orders in a timely manner.

## 2. Fees & Payments
Findivo charges a standard transaction fee (currently 5%) on all successful sales. Payouts are processed according to the platform's weekly schedule.

## 3. Prohibited Items
You may not list illegal, counterfeit, or prohibited items on the platform. Violations will result in immediate account suspension.

## 4. Customer Service
You are responsible for handling customer inquiries, returns, and disputes related to your products in accordance with platform policies.
retailer.privacy:
# Retailer Privacy Policy

## 1. Business Data Collection
We collect your business registration details, tax identification, and banking information solely for verification and payout purposes.

## 2. Store Analytics
We monitor your shop's performance, sales volume, and customer reviews to ensure quality standards and to algorithmically recommend your products to relevant customers.

## 3. Data Security
All financial and proprietary business data is securely encrypted and stored.

## 4. Public Information
Your shop name, logo, location, and product listings will be publicly visible to all Findivo users.

influencer.terms:
# Influencer Terms of Service

Welcome to the Findivo Creator Program!

## 1. Content Guidelines
As an Influencer, you agree to create honest, high-quality content. You must not post misleading reviews, spam, or inappropriate material.

## 2. Commissions & Earnings
You will earn a percentage-based commission for every completed sale generated through your unique tracking links or promo codes.

## 3. Payout Schedule
Commissions are calculated on a rolling basis and paid out according to the platform's payout schedule, subject to a minimum withdrawal threshold.

## 4. Relationship
You operate as an independent contractor. This agreement does not constitute an employment relationship with Findivo.
influencer.privacy:
# Influencer Privacy Policy

## 1. Profile Visibility
Your public profile, including your bio, social media links, and generated content, will be visible to all Findivo users and partner brands.

## 2. Financial Information
We collect your banking or payment gateway details securely for the sole purpose of processing your commission payouts.

## 3. Performance Analytics
We track click-through rates, conversion rates, and sales generated from your content to calculate your earnings accurately and provide you with performance insights.

## 4. Data Sharing
We may share aggregated, non-personally identifiable performance metrics with brands to facilitate potential sponsorships.
